name: repomap
description: AI-powered documentation generator for multi-repo projects

scripts.build: npm run build -w @repomap/core && npm run build -w @repomap/adapter-claude && npm run build -w @repomap/adapter-claude-code && npm run build -w @repomap/adapter-ollama && npm run build -w @repomap/cli
scripts.pack:dry: npm run build && npm pack -w @repomap/core --dry-run && npm pack -w @repomap/adapter-claude --dry-run && npm pack -w @repomap/adapter-claude-code --dry-run && npm pack -w @repomap/adapter-ollama --dry-run && npm pack -w @repomap/cli --dry-run
scripts.publish:all: npm run build && npm publish -w @repomap/core && npm publish -w @repomap/adapter-claude && npm publish -w @repomap/adapter-claude-code && npm publish -w @repomap/adapter-ollama && npm publish -w @repomap/cli
